process.heading: Our Promotional Campaign Management Process
process.subtitle: A data-driven, multi-channel promotional process that maximizes brand reach and customer acquisition — from strategy to execution and continuous optimization.

steps.title: Brand & Audience Analysis
steps.description: We begin by auditing your existing brand presence, understanding your target audience personas, competitive landscape, and promotional goals. We identify the highest-impact channels for your specific business and audience.

steps.title: Strategy & Campaign Planning
steps.description: We build a comprehensive, multi-channel promotional strategy — defining messaging, content themes, channel mix, budget allocation, and KPIs for each campaign. Every campaign has a clear goal and measurable success criteria.

steps.title: Creative Production & Setup
steps.description: Our creative team produces campaign assets — email templates, WhatsApp message scripts, SMS copy, influencer briefs, social creatives, and PR pitches. All content is designed for maximum engagement and conversion.

steps.title: Campaign Launch & Distribution
steps.description: We execute campaigns across all selected channels simultaneously — launching email sequences, scheduling WhatsApp broadcasts, activating influencer posts, distributing press releases, and deploying SMS blasts with precise timing.

steps.title: Optimization & A/B Testing
steps.description: We continuously test and optimize every element — subject lines, send times, influencer content, messaging tone, and CTAs — using data to improve engagement rates, reduce costs, and increase conversions progressively.

steps.title: Reporting & Strategy Refinement
steps.description: We deliver transparent weekly and monthly performance reports covering reach, engagement, open rates, CTR, conversions, cost per acquisition, and ROI across every channel — with clear insights and forward-looking recommendations.

faqs.question: What promotional services does Divrit Technologies offer?
faqs.answer: We offer a full suite of promotional services including influencer marketing, email marketing & automation, WhatsApp marketing via official Business API, bulk SMS campaigns, PR & media outreach, affiliate marketing, and event promotions — all managed under one roof for consistent, cross-channel brand promotion.

faqs.question: How much does influencer marketing cost?
faqs.answer: Influencer marketing costs vary based on influencer tier. Nano influencers (10K–50K followers) typically charge ₹3,000–₹15,000 per post. Micro influencers (50K–500K) range from ₹15,000–₹1,00,000. Macro influencers charge ₹1,00,000–₹10,00,000+. We help you build a campaign within your budget using the right mix of influencer tiers.

faqs.question: What open rates can I expect from WhatsApp marketing?
faqs.answer: WhatsApp marketing through the official Business API delivers 90–98% message open rates — significantly higher than email (20–40%) or SMS (35–50%). This makes it the highest-engagement promotional channel for direct customer communication in India. We set up official API-based campaigns to ensure delivery and compliance.

faqs.question: Can you manage PR and get my brand featured in media?
faqs.answer: Yes. We offer PR services including press release writing and distribution, journalist outreach, guaranteed publication on media portals (YourStory, Inc42, Business Standard, etc.), and brand story placement. PR packages are available based on the type and reach of coverage required.

faqs.question: How quickly will promotional campaigns show results?
faqs.answer: Timelines vary by channel. WhatsApp and SMS campaigns deliver results within 24–48 hours of launch. Influencer campaigns show engagement within days of going live. Email marketing results build over 2–4 weeks. PR campaigns show media coverage within 7–14 days of outreach. Full multi-channel campaign impact is typically measurable within 30–60 days.
